title: Make krn ledger on 30 PRs finish in under a minute
body:
Outcome: `krn ledger --limit 30 --json` finishes in under 60 s on this host, and its per-PR rows are unchanged.
Why: during t-qwqhd1a each 30-PR ledger run took over 600 s (a foreground Bash call timed out at 600 s and moved to the background), so every attribution change costs a long wait per measurement.
Proof: wall time before and after with the same transcripts, plus `diff` of the JSON rows; record under .krn/runs/.
Scope: this repository.
